title: BNPL Management Dashboard: Viewing Projected Early-Payment Rewards
summary: This document explains how the BNPL Management Dashboard displays “projected early-payment rewards,” including the projected rewards total, the projected total across all active plans, and when these values update based on plan details/payment timing. It also covers practical use for prioritizing early installments.
